tricks.name: Skip playing Goron Lullaby by using Iron Boots
tricks.tooltip: By combining Iron Boots to not be blown away by the wind and Goron to roll up the slope, Goron Lullaby can be skipped.

tricks.name: Fewer Tunic Requirements (MM)
tricks.tooltip: Most things that would normally require Zora Tunic no longer will. Pirate Fortress Sewers and Pinnacle Rock will still require it.

tricks.name: Fight Gyorg as Human using Iron Boots and Hookshot
tricks.tooltip: Gyorg can be damaged with Hookshot. Turning this trick on will enable the fight in logic with Iron Boots and Hookshot.

tricks.name: Woodfall Owl Chest with Hover Boots and Jump Slash
tricks.tooltip: The chest can be reached with a tight jump slash at the end of the hover duration.

tricks.name: Woodfall Temple Lobby with Damage Boost and Hover Boots
tricks.tooltip: The lobby can be traversed by damaging yourself with bombs at certain points. Very difficult.

tricks.name: Jump Slash or Damage Boost to the Soaring Tablet with Hover Boots and Bunny Hood
tricks.tooltip: Using Bunny Hood for extra speed, Hover Boots can be used to reach the Soaring Tablet with a tight jump slash or a damage boost with explosives.

tricks.name: Cross Path to Snowhead using Hover Boots
tricks.tooltip: Hover Boots can be used to slide off the slopes on the side and get across the gaps.

tricks.name: Cross GBT Waterwheel Room using Hover Boots
tricks.tooltip: Similar to using Goron, Hover Boots can be used to get on the water wheel and then reach the central room.

tricks.name: Great Bay Temple Center Underwater Pot using only Iron Boots
tricks.tooltip: The pot can be broken by rolling into it, allowing you to collect the Stray Fairy.

tricks.name: Reach the First Red Turnkey in GBT using Hover Boots, Bunny Hood, and a Jump Slash
tricks.tooltip: The red turnkey in front of Wart can be reached with a precise jump slash after the hover duration, using Bunny Hood for extra speed.

tricks.name: Reach the Upper Chest in GBT's Second Green Room using Hover Boots
tricks.tooltip: The upper chest in the green water wheel room can be reached by using Hover Boots to move between the wheel's blades.

tricks.name: Stone Tower Temple Map Chest using Hover Boots
tricks.tooltip: After using the Hookshot to reach the chest on the high platform in the lava room, one can then use the Hover Boots to land on top of the sun block.

tricks.name: Inverted Stone Tower Temple Death Armos using Hover Boots and Bunny Hood
tricks.tooltip: The Death Armos switch can be reached by using the Hover Boots and then sidehopping onto the platform, with Bunny Hood for extra speed.

tricks.name: Stone Tower Updrafts without Deku Mask
tricks.tooltip: This room can be traversed using Recoil Flips or Goron Mask instead of Deku Mask.
